changelog:
- Initial release of the Threads Keyword & Hashtag Search skill.
- Enables searching Threads posts by keyword or hashtag, extracting results from SSR-embedded JSON.
- Returns post details including engagement metrics (likes, replies, reposts, quotes).
- Supports sorting by top or recent posts.
- No authentication/login required; retrieves 17-18 public results per query (no pagination).
- Includes strategies for batch orchestration, error recovery, and experience recording.
summary: Searches Threads posts by keyword or hashtag and returns matching posts with engagement metrics, extracted from SSR-embedded JSON. Use when user asks to search Threads posts, find Threads content by topic, scrape Threads search results, collect Threads posts about a keyword, monitor Threads hashtag
